title: Home-Site Lease Clause: Length of the Late-Fee Grace Period by Tenancy
content:
**Clause — late-fee grace period of the Home-Site Lease**

The grace period is 7 calendar days for a resident with at least 120 full months of tenancy since the move-in date, and 3 calendar days for a resident with fewer than 12 full months. For a resident with at least 12 but fewer than 120 full months this clause sets no different length, and the grace period is the lot class's grace days. However long, the grace period is counted from the day after the due date, and the fee may be posted from the day after the last grace day.

| Full months of tenancy since the move-in date | Grace period |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 7 calendar days |
| fewer than 12 | 3 calendar days |
| 12 to 119 | the lot class's grace days |

**Dates for rent due on the 1st (hypothetical tenures)**

| Tenure | Grace days | Last grace day | Late fee may be posted from |
|---|---|---|---|
| 150 months | 7 | the 8th | the 9th |
| exactly 120 months | 7 | the 8th | the 9th |
| 11 months | 3 | the 4th | the 5th |

At exactly 12 months the resident is no longer below 12 and the 3-day period no longer applies; at 119 months the 7-day period does not yet apply.

Tenancy months are full calendar months from the move-in date on the lease.
